> a local-first business twin for operators.

- First Edition / First Dimension: https://rappter.com/
- Holodex: https://kody-w.github.io/holodex/
- Business twin and waitlist: https://rapterbox.com/#business
- AI assurance: https://rapterbox.com/wrong-game then https://rapterbox.com/invite
- DOGG: https://rapterbox.com/dogg
- Public agent contract: https://rapterbox.com/agent.json

The Holo product and business-box product are separate offers built on the same
RAPP/1 ownership, verification, privacy, and bounded-autonomy model.
